scripts.check: node --check checkin-backend/src/index.js && node --check web/app.js && npm test
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply esp32-checkin-db --local --config checkin-backend/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply esp32-checkin-db --remote --config checkin-backend/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm audit --omit=dev && wrangler deploy --config checkin-backend/wrangler.toml
